title: Does anyone have any theories on how we all have similar dreams?
content: I know we are all connected, but I want to dive deeper. Why do you think we have such similar dream scapes? I have my own theory, but I want to hear others. We leave our body every time we sleep, most just aren’t aware of this happening because their mind falls asleep. I know how to astral travel, so I know how to keep my mind awake while my body’s asleep. I think a lot of these dream scapes are places we go when we leave our body. We travel to different planes, and thus we go to such similar places. I believe in the multiverse theory, so I think there are a lot of variations of “dream scapes”, we can have the same baseline, but with different variations. That’s why they can range from mostly identical to partly identical. I’m trying to keep this short, but that’s part of my theory(s). What do you think? I’d love to hear more theory’s.
